newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar trade closed for national holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar trade closed for national holiday.

text.p: Indian sugar markets were closed on Wednesday for a national holiday to mark Mahatma Gandhi's birth anniversary, dealers said. They reopen on Thursday.
On Tuesday, Indian sugar prices fell on low consumer demand and excess stocks, they said.
S-30 sugar fell by six rupees to 1,250/1,274 rupees per quintal while M-30 eased by 5/10 rupees to 1,280/1,325. Sugar mill delivery fell to 1,170/1,180 rupees from 1,200/1,210.
Dealers said overall sentiment was subdued but some traders expected stray festival support at lower levels.
